intro.text: A Herdazian tool for striking fire that can double as an ornament.

description.text: In the warcamps on the Shattered Plains, a Herdazian used one with oil to throw bursts of flame into the air.
The Mink brought a sparkflicker to the coalition's fighting in Emul and absently struck sparks with it while talking with Jasnah Kholin after a battle.
